# pcd_networking_port_ids (Data Source)

Look up the IDs of all Neutron ports matching the given filters, sorted ascending.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_network" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-network"
}

data "pcd_networking_port_ids" "example" {
  network_id     = pcd_networking_network.example.id
  device_owner   = "network:router_interface"
  admin_state_up = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Filter by administrative state.
- `device_id` (String) Filter by device ID.
- `device_owner` (String) Filter by device owner.
- `mac_address` (String) Filter by MAC address.
- `name` (String) Filter by name.
- `network_id` (String) Filter by network.
- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.
- `status` (String) Filter by operational status.
- `tenant_id` (String) Filter by owning project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A stable hash of the matched port IDs.
- `ids` (List of String) The matched port IDs, sorted ascending.
